sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Wet Job - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "My partners are very interested in our new venture. The Blue Helmets inspected the location you mentioned and discovered that some kind of fisherman lived there. It appears he has been dead for quite some time, and the people with the cameras were his friends. We know he was acquainted with someone named Artyom, who was often seen driving a yellow sedan. Their shared activities were somehow connected to the Russian military. Now you understand why this could be interesting? Most likely, Artyom's vehicle is still somewhere on the road along the shore. Search for it based on the description and mark it. The Blue Helmets will immediately search the area. This way, we can find out who Artyom really is."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate Artyom's car on Shoreline
- Mark Artyom's car with MS2000 Marker

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- 1,900 Dollars
  - 1,995 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 2,185 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× NcSTAR ADO P4 Sniper 3-9x42 riflescope
- 2× .300 Blackout M62 Tracer ammo pack (50 pcs)
- Unlocks craft for .300 Blackout M62 Tracer at Workbench level 2
"So, the vehicle was intact? No signs of an attack, correct? We'll investigate further. I believe there is still much more to discover."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to find Artyom's car on Shoreline. The car is yellow and located on the main road along the shore. It can be found next to a yellow bus and a police car.
